$comment: Canvas tool contract (docs/ai-integration.md § Agent tool set). Advertised by the Rust MCP server (include_str!) and executed by src/agent/sceneTools.ts. Every tool accepts optional tabId (default: active tab). Read tools return `revision`; edit tools accept `expectedRevision` and fail with a conflict if the scene changed.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List open canvas tabs with id, title, element count, and whether the agent may edit it (viewer tabs in a live collab session are read-only).

tools.name: get_scene_summary
tools.description: Compact one-row-per-element summary (id, type, x, y, w, h, text, colors, bindings, shape data) plus scene bounds and revision. Paginate with cursor, or filter by bbox or ids. Call this before editing.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Return the ids and summaries of the user's currently selected elements, plus revision.

tools.name: get_elements
tools.description: Return full Excalidraw element JSON for the given ids, plus revision, and a data map of each element's shape data (key → value) when any has some.

tools.name: render_canvas_png
tools.description: Render the canvas to a PNG (longest side <= 1280px) so you can see the result. scope: all | viewport | selection | ids.

tools.name: add_elements
tools.description: Add elements in Excalidraw skeleton format (type rectangle|ellipse|diamond|text|arrow|line|frame, x, y, width, height, label {text}, strokeColor, backgroundColor, start/end {id} for arrows). Optional agent-chosen ids must not collide. Returns created ids and new revision. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: update_elements
tools.description: Patch existing elements. Allowed fields: x, y (absolute), width, height, angle, strokeColor, backgroundColor, fillStyle, strokeWidth, strokeStyle, roughness, opacity, text (on a container sets its label; empty removes it), fontSize, fontFamily, textAlign, roundness ("round" | "sharp"), locked, link. Bound labels move with their container and bound arrows are re-routed. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Delete elements by id (also removes their bound text and dangling bound arrows). Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Draw an arrow bound to two existing elements (it follows them when they move), optionally labeled. elbow: true draws an orthogonal (elbow) arrow. startAnchor / endAnchor pin an end to the n, e, s or w side of its shape (center = the side facing the other shape, chosen now) and imply elbow; unpinned elbow ends also face the other shape. style may set strokeColor, strokeWidth, strokeStyle, roughness, opacity, startArrowhead, endArrowhead. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: add_mermaid
tools.description: Convert Mermaid source (flowchart, sequence, class...) to native Excalidraw elements, placed at x/y or by default to the right of existing content. Reports imageFallback when the diagram type could only be rendered as an image. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: add_image
tools.description: Place a raster or SVG image (png, jpeg, gif, webp, svg; up to 10 MB) on the canvas, e.g. a photo, logo, icon or screenshot. Pass either path (a file inside your working directory / session folder or the attached folder; relative paths resolve against your working directory; other locations are rejected) or data (base64, no data: prefix) plus mimeType. If another tool returned the image bytes, pass them here directly as data; don't repeat, store or re-save them, and prefer small images. URLs are not supported: save or create the file in your working directory first. Size: width and/or height in canvas px (aspect ratio is kept when you give only one); default is the image's own size, capped at 400px. Position: x/y (top-left), or inside = an element id (card, shape or frame) to fit the image within that element's bounds with padding (x/y/width/height then override). Scripted SVG (script, event handlers, foreignObject, external links) is rejected. Returns the new image element id. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

path.description: Image file inside the session folder or the attached folder.

data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (use with mimeType instead of path).

inside.description: Element id to fit the image inside (frames also adopt it).

padding.description: Inset from the inside element's edges (default 8).

id.description: Optional id for the new image element.

tools.name: arrange
tools.description: Arrange elements. action align: value left|center|right|top|middle|bottom. distribute: value horizontal|vertical. grid: columns, gap. group / ungroup. zorder: value front|back. frame: value = a frame id to put the elements in, or "none" to take them out. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: set_viewport
tools.description: Scroll/zoom the user's view to fit the given ids (or the whole scene); optional fixed zoom 0.1-30. Does not change the drawing or create an undo step.

tools.name: find_elements
tools.description: Search the canvas. All filters are optional and combined with AND: text (case-insensitive substring of an element's text, its shape label or a frame name; set regex: true to treat it as a regular expression), types, strokeColor, backgroundColor, groupId, frameId, bbox, dataKey (elements with that shape-data key; add dataValue to match its value exactly). Returns compact rows like get_scene_summary (up to limit, default 100) plus the total match count.

tools.name: select_elements
tools.description: Set the user's selection on the canvas (highlights elements so the user can see or act on them). mode replace (default) | add | remove | clear. Label ids resolve to their shape. reveal: true also scrolls the view to the selection. Does not change the drawing or create an undo step; works in view-only tabs.

tools.name: get_canvas_state
tools.description: Canvas-level state: visible viewport rectangle and zoom, scene bounds, element count, selected ids, theme, background color, grid, view/zen mode, active tool, and the current default styles for new elements (currentItemStyle). Use it to place new content in view or next to existing content.

tools.name: move_elements
tools.description: Move elements by a relative offset (dx, dy in scene px). Labels follow their shapes, frames bring their contents, and bound arrows are re-routed. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: duplicate_elements
tools.description: Copy elements, offset by dx/dy (default 20/20). Copies labels, frame contents, and arrows whose both ends are copied; bindings and groups among the copies are preserved. Returns created: {originalId: newId}. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: set_canvas
tools.description: Change canvas settings: viewBackgroundColor (saved with the drawing, undoable) and/or gridModeEnabled (view-only preference).

tools.name: auto_layout
tools.description: Automatically lay out a diagram with ELK (runs locally). ids: the elements to lay out (groups, frame contents and labels come along); omit for the whole canvas. algorithm layered (default; flowcharts, pipelines, any graph) or tree (hierarchies such as org charts). direction down (default), right, up or left. spacing: gap between shapes in px (default 60). Arrows bound at both ends become the graph's edges and are re-routed; groups and frames move as single nodes. Works inside apply_ops (e.g. add shapes + connect, then auto_layout). Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: apply_ops
tools.description: Run several edit operations atomically: if any op fails nothing is applied. Each op is {tool, args} using add_elements, update_elements, delete_elements, connect, add_mermaid, add_image, arrange, move_elements, duplicate_elements, auto_layout, update_layer, set_shape_data, set_arrow_anchors, create_component, insert_instance, set_overrides, reset_overrides, detach_instance, apply_extension, or remove_extension (omit tabId/expectedRevision inside ops; extension ops must target elements no earlier op in the batch changed). Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: apply_extension
tools.description: Apply (or re-apply with new params) an extension to elements, as one undoable change. Built-in app extensions store their settings in the element's customData and write standard Excalidraw output (ordinary element fields and image files), so the file still renders in stock Excalidraw. Extensions on one element stack in a fixed order (grayscale → tint → mask → border → shadow); every change re-renders the original through the whole stack, so e.g. a border follows the current mask shape. get_scene_summary rows show applied extensions as ext and edited-elsewhere ones as extStale. Applying one extension keeps the others; re-applying replaces its params. Elements it doesn't apply to are returned in skipped. Extensions: grayscale: Desaturate an image by an amount from 0 to 100%; presets grayscale (Grayscale). tint: Tint an image towards a colour, keeping its light and shade; presets tint (Tint). mask: Mask an image to a circle or rounded rectangle; presets circle (Circle), roundedRect (Rounded rectangle). border: Draw a border inside the image edge that follows any mask shape (solid, dashed or dotted; sketchy like native shapes); presets thin (Thin), bold (Bold), extraBold (Extra bold). shadow: Drop shadow behind the image (follows any mask), drawn outside its edge; presets soft (Soft), drop (Drop), hard (Hard). Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

preset.description: A preset of the chosen extension (the same actions the app UI offers).

params.description: Extension parameters; merged over the preset's params when both are given. Schema per extension below.

strength.description: Tint strength in % (100 = fully recoloured, keeping light and shade)

radius.description: roundedRect corner radius, % of the shorter side

width.description: Stroke width in scene units, drawn inside the image edge (Excalidraw: thin 1, bold 2, extra bold 4)

offsetX.description: Horizontal offset in scene units (positive = right)

offsetY.description: Vertical offset in scene units (positive = down)

blur.description: Blur radius in scene units (0 = hard shadow)

tools.name: remove_extension
tools.description: Remove one extension from elements, keeping the others (removing the last restores the original image), as one undoable change. Built-in app extensions store their settings in the element's customData and write standard Excalidraw output (ordinary element fields and image files), so the file still renders in stock Excalidraw. Extensions on one element stack in a fixed order (grayscale → tint → mask → border → shadow); every change re-renders the original through the whole stack, so e.g. a border follows the current mask shape. get_scene_summary rows show applied extensions as ext and edited-elsewhere ones as extStale. Elements where it isn't applied (or is stale) are returned in skipped and left alone. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: List the canvas as a layer tree (the Layers tab in the sidebar): frames first, then groups (nested innermost inside outermost) and elements, topmost first. Each row has id (an element id, or a groupId for groups), kind frame | group | element, type, label (custom name, frame name, text, shape label, or type), name when the user or agent set one, locked (a group is locked when all its members are), depth, parent and elementCount. Shape labels are folded into their shape.

tools.name: update_layer
tools.description: Rename and/or lock a layer from list_layers. id is an element id or a groupId. name sets the layer name shown in the Layers tab (an empty string clears it); frames are renamed through their own frame name, elements and groups store it in customData["excalidrawDesktop.layer"]. locked locks or unlocks the element (with its label), every member of a group, or just the frame itself. One undo step.

tools.name: set_shape_data
tools.description: Set key/value shape data on elements (any type) as one undoable change. Data is plain strings stored in the element's customData, so it survives save, reload and collaboration, and shows in get_scene_summary rows as data. set maps key → value (strings, numbers and booleans are stored as strings; null removes the key); existing keys keep their order and new keys are appended. replace: true drops every key not in set. Keys are trimmed, 1-100 characters; values up to 10,000 characters; at most 200 keys per element. Data written by a newer app version is read-only and fails. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: set_arrow_anchors
tools.description: Pin the bound ends of elbow arrows to a side of the shape they're bound to: n (top), e (right), s (bottom), w (left), or center (the side facing the other end, chosen now; it doesn't follow later moves). The arrow is re-routed; one undoable change. Only elbow arrows whose end is bound to a shape can be anchored (draw one with connect elbow: true). get_scene_summary rows show elbow arrows' startAnchor / endAnchor. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: get_shape_data
tools.description: Read shape data (key/value pairs) for the given ids, or for every element that has any when ids is omitted. Each element comes with its type and label (its text, or a shape's label). format: "csv" returns one CSV table instead (columns id, type, label, then every key), the same as the app's "Copy data as CSV".

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Turn elements into a reusable component (Figma/Sketch style): the elements become the component's master, grouped under one component group. ids: the elements (labels/bound text come along; an existing group that is exactly the selection becomes the component group). name: optional display name. Elements already in a component can't be used (no nesting). Returns componentId and masterGroupId. Then insert_instance places live copies: editing the master (update_elements on its elements, adding to or removing from its group) updates every instance. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: insert_instance
tools.description: Place a new instance of a component. component: the componentId (or any element/group id of its master or an instance). x, y: top-left of the instance (default: right of the master). scale: uniform scale (default 1). angle: rotation in degrees. Instances follow the master's geometry, styles and text live; move, resize or rotate the whole instance group freely. Returns groupId (select/move it as a unit) and the child ids. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List the components on the canvas: componentId, name, masterGroupId and masterIds (null/empty when the master was deleted and no instance could be promoted), and each instance's groupId, child ids and number of overridden slots. get_scene_summary rows also carry cmp {id, role, slot, group, overrides} for component elements; get_elements returns a components map.

tools.name: set_overrides
tools.description: Override per-slot values on one instance so they stop following the master: text, backgroundColor, strokeColor, opacity, link, fileId (text for text elements; fileId for images; opacity 0-100). instance: the instance groupId or any of its element ids. overrides: [{elementId (instance child) or slot (master element id), values: {key: value or null to clear}}]. Direct update_elements edits to these keys on an instance child become overrides too; edits to other properties of an instance child are reverted to the master's. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: reset_overrides
tools.description: Clear overrides on an instance so it follows the master again. instance: groupId or any of its element ids. Optionally limit to slots, elementIds and/or keys; omit all three to reset everything. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

tools.name: detach_instance
tools.description: Detach an instance from its component: its elements become ordinary elements (they keep their group, position and current look) and stop following the master. instance: groupId or any of its element ids. Pass expectedRevision (from the last read) to fail instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

internalTools.name: approve
internalTools.description: Internal: Claude Code --permission-prompt-tool target. Handled in Rust (routes to an in-app approval card); never forwarded to the webview.
